_comment: The cockpit's own map, for the assistant: every view and control, where it is and what it does. Keep it in step with the page: the cockpit tests check that every view here is in the page's route table (core.js PAGE_ROUTES) with the same route, and that every control appears as data-control.

views.label: Home
views.purpose: the dashboard for your lens: key figures, decisions waiting, the delivery square, health and more, in your own layout

views.label: Delivery square
views.purpose: needs arriving from the operation, concepts to validate, the factory, end-user feedback and what runs in production

views.label: Capability catalogue
views.purpose: every capability: in use, pilot or proposed, what it does, and whether its capability pack is valid

views.label: Projects
views.purpose: every project with its state, now line and health

views.label: All decisions
views.purpose: every card you may decide across projects, including updates and concepts, by kind, project or age

views.label: Insight (Floor)
views.purpose: the factory across all projects: gate pass rate, pipeline, models, spend

views.label: Settings
views.purpose: embeds for websites, appearance, and sign-in links for another tab

views.label: Overview
views.purpose: a project's health, forecast, now line and what waits on you

views.label: Inbox
views.purpose: the cards you may decide, with the verdicts you may give

views.label: Questions
views.purpose: the panel's questions with options; answer or let Rihma assume

views.label: Assumptions
views.purpose: what Rihma assumed, with due dates; confirm or refute

views.label: Plan
views.purpose: the plan waiting for approval; edit a requirement, approve or reject with a reason

views.label: Spec & contract
views.purpose: requirements and criteria with sources and evidence chips

views.label: Tasks
views.purpose: the task board, timeline or table, and the live view of the running cell

views.label: Cell
views.purpose: every Gnomon run: role, model, verdict, chain, tokens, cost

views.label: Releases
views.purpose: deliveries with their capability pack: environments, holdouts, shadow, canary

views.label: Try it
views.purpose: the checklist against the running release, and reporting what you saw

views.label: Changes
views.purpose: report a change or feedback; see triage and impact

views.label: Ledger
views.purpose: every recorded event, who acted, and whether the chain is intact

views.label: Evidence
views.purpose: the attestation, the control table and the evidence pack export, for compliance

views.label: Jobs
views.purpose: background runs started from the cockpit

controls.label: Persona switcher
controls.does: changes whose view you see and what you may decide

controls.label: Lens switcher
controls.does: shows the same work for a purpose: business, concept, delivery, operations, compliance or insight

controls.label: Pause
controls.does: asks the project to stop at the next safe point

controls.label: Resume
controls.does: lets a paused project continue

controls.label: Answer
controls.does: records your answer as the owner's word

controls.label: Let Rihma assume
controls.does: takes the panel's proposal as an assumption with a due date

controls.label: Verdict buttons
controls.where: an Inbox card, or the decisions widget
controls.does: decides the card with your name and persona

controls.label: Report a change
controls.does: files feedback or a change; it is triaged and routed back

controls.label: Comment
controls.does: adds a remark without deciding anything; it can be promoted into a change

controls.label: Jump to (Ctrl+K)
controls.does: jumps to any page, project, view or open card

controls.label: Assistant
controls.does: answers questions about the cockpit and your projects, and proposes actions you confirm

controls.label: Customize
controls.does: rearranges, resizes, adds or removes the dashboard's widgets; Done saves your own layout

controls.label: Theme
controls.does: switches dark, light or system, the accent colour and the corners

controls.label: Density
controls.does: switches between comfortable and compact spacing

controls.label: New project
controls.does: starts a project from a need: its work profile, maturity and mode

controls.label: Log a signal
controls.does: records a need that arrived from the operation, to be triaged

controls.label: Validate a concept
controls.does: turns a concept into a project, after you edit its title, profile, maturity and mode

controls.label: Export evidence pack
controls.where: a project's Evidence tab and the Compliance lens
controls.does: exports a zip with the attestation, decisions, gate verdicts and the whole record, downloaded once

controls.label: Build the capability pack
controls.does: builds the latest release's capability pack, signed with your name; a new version only when what it names changed. Showing the pack never builds it

controls.label: Create an embed
controls.does: makes a chat window for a website that files feedback or needs; its key is shown once

controls.label: Autonomy cap
controls.where: the Compliance lens and the project header
controls.does: sets how far the factory may act alone, with a reason
